# Top End Solar & Electrical, Darwin NT
These are fictional test records as at 9 November 2026.

## Open customer jobs
- Customer Maya Chen, Nightcliff home, job TES-101. Install 12 Trina 440W Panels, one Fronius Primo 5kW Inverter and one Fronius Smart Meter. Crew A, due 12 November.
- Customer Daniel Wilson, Palmerston home, job TES-102. Needs one Clipsal Switchboard, six Hager RCBOs and four Weatherproof GPOs. Crew B, due 12 November.
- Customer Wattle Creek School, Berrimah, job TES-103. Needs one Fronius Symo 10kW Inverter, 24 Jinko 475W Panels and two Solar Cable 6mm 100m drums. Crew A, due 13 November.
- Customer Red Plains Cattle Station, Adelaide River, job TES-104. Needs one Fronius Backup Switch, 20 LONGi 500W Panels and four Earth Rods. Crew C, due 14 November.
- Customer Aisha Brown, Rapid Creek home, job TES-105. Needs two LED Batten 1200mm fittings and one TPS Cable 2.5mm 100m drum. Crew B, due 13 November.
- Customer Casuarina Community Hall, job TES-106. Needs six DC Isolators, four Solar Rail 4.2m lengths and two Panel Earthing Kits. Crew C, due 14 November.

## Inbound delivery
Crew ute Ute 3 is carrying delivery IN-77 from Rexel Darwin and Fronius Australia, expected 11 November. It holds one Fronius Primo 5kW Inverter for TES-101, one Clipsal Switchboard for TES-102, one Fronius Symo 10kW Inverter for TES-103 and one Fronius Backup Switch for TES-104. A one-day delay risks those four jobs. Ute 3 is allocated to Crew A.

## Decisions and unconfirmed information
Decision: call-out fee goes to $120 from 1 December 2026, approved by owner Priya Nair.
Rumour, unconfirmed: Fronius Australia may raise prices in December. Do not treat it as a confirmed increase.
Rexel Darwin is our electrical wholesaler. Fronius Australia supplies inverters and monitoring equipment. Both are organisations we work with.
Unlinked equipment: Label Printer 2 sits in the office, with no recorded dependencies.

content.text:
The space is built and everything is proposed, but nothing is approved. The owner has to approve it before the stock list imports or any number can run.

**Space:** "Top End Solar & Electrical" (an org space).

**Stored**
- Both files, `stock.csv` and `jobs-notes.md`, are uploaded.
- 23 notes are written. The kinds are customer, job, crew, vehicle, delivery, decision, equipment and product, plus the existing person and organisation kinds.
- 17 product placeholders exist, named exactly as in the stock list, so jobs can link to them.
- The call-out fee decision ($120 from 1 December, approved by Priya Nair) is saved as a fact.
- The Fronius price rise is saved as an unconfirmed rumour, labelled "do not use in costings".

**Links (50 in all)**
- Each of the 6 customers is linked to their job.
- Each job is linked to the stock it needs (17 links), with the quantity in the link reason.
- Ute 3 carries IN-77 and is allocated to Crew A.
- IN-77 supplies jobs TES-101 to TES-104, holds the four matching items, and comes from Rexel Darwin and Fronius Australia.
- Crews are linked to their jobs.
- The fee decision is linked to Priya Nair.
- Label Printer 2 has no links, as the notes say.

**Auto-map of the stock CSV:** It proposed a product kind, 6 typed properties and 3 metrics.
- It also proposed a separate "supplier" kind. I proposed folding that into organisation, since the suppliers already exist as organisations.
- The CSV rows are not imported yet. That needs owner approval first.

**Ontology proposed**
- **Kinds:** product, customer, job, crew, vehicle, delivery, decision and equipment, plus the supplier merge.
- **Properties:**
  - product: sell_price, unit_cost and qty_on_hand
  - job: job_number, due_date and suburb
  - delivery: expected_date
  - decision: effective_date and amount
- **Link types (10):** has_job, needs, supplies_job, contains, carries, allocated_to, assigned_to, supplied_by (two of them) and approved_by.
- **Metrics (7):**
  - average sell price
  - total stock value at cost
  - total stock value at sell price
  - gross margin
  - average unit cost
  - back-ordered item count
  - job count

**Problems for the owner to know about**
- Fronius Backup Switch and Cable Tie Pack have no unit cost. Stock value at cost and gross margin will leave them out or skew until someone fills the costs in.
- The Fronius Primo and Symo inverters are at 3 and 2 units, with reorder at 10. Two other items are also under 10: the Fronius Datamanager (5) and the Clipsal Switchboard (8). Most of the stock list is ordinary, but a few jobs lean on thin stock.
- A one-day delay on IN-77 hits TES-101 to TES-104.

**Next step for the owner:** approve the proposals in the Eunomia app, then I can import the stock rows and run the metrics.
